    <script>
    let js_script_list = [],
        chead = document.head || document.body || document.documentElement;

    function loadScript(src, cb) {

        let i = js_script_list.length, load_check = false;
        while (i--) {
            if (js_script_list[i] === src) {
                load_check = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if(!load_check){
            js_script_list.push(src);
            var s = document.createElement('script');
            s.src = src;
            chead.appendChild(s);
            s.onload = cb;
            s.onerror = cb;
            return s;
        }else{
            if (cb !== undefined && typeof(cb) === "function") {
                cb();
            }
        }
    }
</script>
    <script>
    (() => {
        if (typeof window.getUpTrafficAttribution === 'function') {
            return;
        }

        const attributionCookieName = 'up_attribution';
        const attributionLifetimeSeconds = 30 * 24 * 60 * 60;
        const attributionParamNames = ['source', 'medium', 'campaign', 'content', 'term'];
        const sourceAliases = {
            'utm_source': 'source',
            'utm_medium': 'medium',
            'utm_campaign': 'campaign',
            'utm_content': 'content',
            'utm_term': 'term',
        };
        const upLabelsCookieName = 'up_labels_attribution';
        const upLabelParamNames = ['source', 'medium', 'campaign'];
        const excludedReferrerHostnames = [
            'accounts.google.com',
        ];
        const searchSources = [
            'google.',
            'bing.com',
            'search.yahoo.com',
            'search.aol.com',
            'duckduckgo.com',
            'search.brave.com',
            'yandex.',
            'baidu.com',
            'ecosia.org',
            'qwant.com',
            'ukr.net',
        ];
        const socialSources = [
            'facebook.com',
            'instagram.com',
            'linkedin.com',
            't.me',
            'telegram.me',
            'telegram.org',
            'tiktok.com',
            'twitter.com',
            'x.com',
            'threads.net',
            'reddit.com',
            'pinterest.com',
            'snapchat.com',
            'viber.com',
        ];
        const videoSources = [
            'youtube.com',
            'youtu.be',
            'vimeo.com',
            'dailymotion.com',
            'twitch.tv',
        ];
        const emailSources = [
            'mail.google.com',
            'mail.yahoo.com',
            'outlook.live.com',
            'outlook.office.com',
            'mail.ukr.net',
            'mail.meta.ua',
        ];

        const normalizeValue = (value) => {
            if (value === undefined || value === null) {
                return null;
            }

            const normalized = String(value).trim();

            return normalized === '' ? null : normalized;
        };

        const normalizeHostname = (hostname) => {
            return normalizeValue(hostname)?.toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./, '') ?? null;
        };

        const getCookie = (name) => {
            const escapedName = name.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
            const match = document.cookie.match(new RegExp(`(?:^|; )${escapedName}=([^;]*)`));

            return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : null;
        };

        const getRegistrableDomain = (hostname) => {
            const normalizedHostname = normalizeHostname(hostname);

            if (!normalizedHostname) {
                return null;
            }

            if (
                normalizedHostname === 'localhost'
                || normalizedHostname.endsWith('.local')
                || /^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$/.test(normalizedHostname)
            ) {
                return normalizedHostname;
            }

            const parts = normalizedHostname.split('.');

            if (normalizedHostname.endsWith('.com.ua') && parts.length >= 3) {
                return parts.slice(-3).join('.');
            }

            return parts.length >= 2 ? parts.slice(-2).join('.') : normalizedHostname;
        };

        const resolveCookieDomain = () => {
            const registrableDomain = getRegistrableDomain(window.location.hostname);

            if (
                !registrableDomain
                || registrableDomain === 'localhost'
                || registrableDomain.endsWith('.local')
                || /^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$/.test(registrableDomain)
            ) {
                return null;
            }

            return `.${registrableDomain}`;
        };

        const setCookie = (name, value) => {
            const cookieParts = [
                `${name}=${encodeURIComponent(value)}`,
                'path=/',
                `max-age=${attributionLifetimeSeconds}`,
                'SameSite=Lax',
            ];

            const cookieDomain = resolveCookieDomain();

            if (cookieDomain) {
                cookieParts.push(`domain=${cookieDomain}`);
            }

            if (window.location.protocol === 'https:') {
                cookieParts.push('Secure');
            }

            document.cookie = cookieParts.join('; ');
        };

        const normalizeAttribution = (payload) => {
            if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') {
                return null;
            }

            const normalized = {};

            attributionParamNames.forEach((paramName) => {
                normalized[paramName] = normalizeValue(
                    payload[paramName] ?? payload[`utm_${paramName}`] ?? payload[`session_${paramName}`]
                );
            });

            if (normalized.source === 'direct') {
                normalized.medium = normalized.medium ?? 'none';
            }

            const hasAnyValue = attributionParamNames.some((paramName) => normalized[paramName] !== null);

            return hasAnyValue ? normalized : null;
        };

        const readStoredAttribution = () => {
            const rawCookie = getCookie(attributionCookieName);

            if (!rawCookie) {
                return null;
            }

            try {
                return normalizeAttribution(JSON.parse(rawCookie));
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        };

        const writeStoredAttribution = (payload) => {
            const normalized = normalizeAttribution(payload);

            if (!normalized) {
                return null;
            }

            const existingAttribution = readStoredAttribution();

            if (normalized.source === 'direct' && existingAttribution) {
                return existingAttribution;
            }

            setCookie(attributionCookieName, JSON.stringify(normalized));

            return normalized;
        };

        const normalizeUpLabels = (payload) => {
            if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') {
                return null;
            }

            const normalized = {};

            upLabelParamNames.forEach((paramName) => {
                normalized[paramName] = normalizeValue(payload[paramName]);
            });

            const hasAnyValue = upLabelParamNames.some((paramName) => normalized[paramName] !== null);

            return hasAnyValue ? normalized : null;
        };

        const readStoredUpLabels = () => {
            const rawCookie = getCookie(upLabelsCookieName);

            if (!rawCookie) {
                return null;
            }

            try {
                return normalizeUpLabels(JSON.parse(rawCookie));
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        };

        const writeStoredUpLabels = (payload) => {
            const normalized = normalizeUpLabels(payload);

            if (!normalized) {
                return null;
            }

            setCookie(upLabelsCookieName, JSON.stringify(normalized));

            return normalized;
        };

        const getUrlUpLabels = () => {
            if (typeof window.URLSearchParams === 'undefined') {
                return null;
            }

            const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const payload = {};

            upLabelParamNames.forEach((paramName) => {
                payload[paramName] = normalizeValue(searchParams.get(`up_${paramName}`));
            });

            return normalizeUpLabels(payload);
        };

        const resolveUpLabels = () => {
            const urlUpLabels = getUrlUpLabels();

            if (urlUpLabels) {
                return writeStoredUpLabels(urlUpLabels);
            }

            return readStoredUpLabels();
        };

        const getUrlUtmAttribution = () => {
            if (typeof window.URLSearchParams === 'undefined') {
                return null;
            }

            const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const payload = {};
            let hasUtmValue = false;

            Object.entries(sourceAliases).forEach(([utmParamName, attributionParamName]) => {
                const value = normalizeValue(searchParams.get(utmParamName));

                payload[attributionParamName] = value;

                if (value !== null) {
                    hasUtmValue = true;
                }
            });

            return hasUtmValue ? normalizeAttribution(payload) : null;
        };

        const matchesKnownSource = (hostname, patterns) => {
            return patterns.some((pattern) => hostname === pattern || hostname.endsWith(`.${pattern}`));
        };

        const isExcludedReferrerHostname = (hostname) => {
            return hostname ? excludedReferrerHostnames.includes(hostname) : false;
        };

        const detectReferrerMedium = (hostname) => {
            if (!hostname) {
                return 'none';
            }

            if (matchesKnownSource(hostname, searchSources)) {
                return 'organic';
            }

            if (matchesKnownSource(hostname, socialSources)) {
                return 'social';
            }

            if (matchesKnownSource(hostname, videoSources)) {
                return 'video';
            }

            if (matchesKnownSource(hostname, emailSources)) {
                return 'email';
            }

            return 'referral';
        };

        const parseReferrerUrl = () => {
            const referrer = document.referrer || '';

            if (!referrer) {
                return null;
            }

            try {
                return new URL(referrer);
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        };

        const isGoogleDiscoverReferrer = (referrerUrl) => {
            if (!referrerUrl) {
                return false;
            }

            const hostname = normalizeHostname(referrerUrl.hostname);
            const protocol = referrerUrl.protocol.toLowerCase();
            const fullReferrer = document.referrer || '';

            if (
                protocol === 'android-app:'
                && hostname === 'com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox'
            ) {
                return true;
            }

            return Boolean(
                hostname
                && hostname.indexOf('google.') !== -1
                && (
                    referrerUrl.searchParams.get('utm_source') === 'discover'
                    || referrerUrl.searchParams.get('source') === 'discover'
                    || fullReferrer.indexOf('googleapis.com/auth/chrome-content-suggestions') !== -1
                )
            );
        };

        const buildDirectAttribution = () => ({
            source: 'direct',
            medium: 'none',
            campaign: null,
            content: null,
            term: null,
        });

        const getReferrerAttribution = () => {
            const referrerUrl = parseReferrerUrl();

            if (!referrerUrl) {
                return buildDirectAttribution();
            }

            const referrerHostname = normalizeHostname(referrerUrl.hostname);
            const currentDomain = getRegistrableDomain(window.location.hostname);
            const referrerDomain = getRegistrableDomain(referrerHostname);

            if (
                !referrerHostname
                || isExcludedReferrerHostname(referrerHostname)
                || (currentDomain && referrerDomain === currentDomain)
            ) {
                return buildDirectAttribution();
            }

            return {
                source: referrerHostname,
                medium: detectReferrerMedium(referrerHostname),
                campaign: null,
                content: null,
                term: null,
            };
        };

        const resolveAttribution = () => {
            const utmAttribution = getUrlUtmAttribution();

            if (utmAttribution) {
                return writeStoredAttribution(utmAttribution);
            }

            const existingAttribution = readStoredAttribution();
            const referrerAttribution = getReferrerAttribution();

            if (referrerAttribution.source === 'direct') {
                if (existingAttribution) {
                    return existingAttribution;
                }

                return writeStoredAttribution(referrerAttribution);
            }

            return writeStoredAttribution(referrerAttribution);
        };

        const mapAttributionToSessionUtmParams = (attribution) => {
            const normalized = normalizeAttribution(attribution);

            return {
                session_source: normalized?.source ?? null,
                session_medium: normalized?.medium ?? null,
                session_campaign: normalized?.campaign ?? null,
                session_content: normalized?.content ?? null,
                session_term: normalized?.term ?? null,
            };
        };

        const mapToSessionUpLabelParams = (upLabels) => {
            const normalized = normalizeUpLabels(upLabels);

            return {
                up_source: normalized?.source ?? null,
                up_medium: normalized?.medium ?? null,
                up_campaign: normalized?.campaign ?? null,
            };
        };

        resolveAttribution();
        resolveUpLabels();

        window.getUpTrafficAttribution = () => readStoredAttribution();
        window.getSessionUtmParams = () => mapAttributionToSessionUtmParams(readStoredAttribution());
        window.getSessionUpLabelParams = () => mapToSessionUpLabelParams(readStoredUpLabels());
        window.getUpReferrerSource = () => {
            const referrerUrl = parseReferrerUrl();

            if (!referrerUrl) {
                return 'direct';
            }

            if (isGoogleDiscoverReferrer(referrerUrl)) {
                return 'google_discover';
            }

            return null;
        };
    })();
</script>

<script>
    (() => {
        const form = document.getElementById('loginForm');
        const returnUrlInput = document.getElementById('loginReturnUrl');
        const googleLoginLink = document.getElementById('googleLoginLink');
        const partnerStorageHandlerUrl = "https:\/\/epravda.com.ua\/paywall\/external-storage-handler";
        const partnerQuickLoginWrap = document.getElementById('partnerQuickLoginWrap');
        const partnerOrigin = partnerStorageHandlerUrl ? new URL(partnerStorageHandlerUrl).origin : null;
        let partnerStatusPopup = null;

        form.addEventListener('submit', async function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();

            if (returnUrlInput) {
                returnUrlInput.value = window.location.href;
            }

            const formData = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form));

            try {
                const response = await fetch(form.action, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    credentials: 'same-origin',
                    headers: {
                        'Accept': 'application/json',
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'X-CSRF-TOKEN': formData._token,
                        'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify(formData)
                });

                const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || '';

                if (!contentType.includes('application/json')) {
                    if (response.redirected && response.url) {
                        modal.classList.remove('active');
                        window.location.href = response.url;
                        return;
                    }

                    throw new Error(`Unexpected response type: ${contentType || 'unknown'}`);
                }

                const data = await response.json();

                if (response.ok) {
                    modal.classList.remove('active');
                    window.location.href = data.redirect || window.location.href;
                } else if (data.errors) {
                    showErrors(data.errors);
                    // reportLoginError(Object.values(data.errors).flat().join(' | '));
                } else if (data.message) {
                    // reportLoginError(data.message);
                    alert(data.message);
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Login error:', error);
                reportLoginError(error.message || 'Login request failed');
            }
        });

        if (googleLoginLink) {
            googleLoginLink.addEventListener('click', function() {
                const url = new URL(googleLoginLink.href);
                url.searchParams.set('return_url', window.location.href);
                googleLoginLink.href = url.toString();
            });
        }

        function showErrors(errors) {
            const container = document.getElementById('loginErrors');
            container.innerHTML = '';

            Object.values(errors).forEach(errArr => {
                errArr.forEach(err => {
                    container.innerHTML += `<div class="form_error">${err}</div>`;
                });
            });
        }

        function reportLoginError(errorMessage) {
            if (!errorMessage) {
                return;
            }

            const errorUrl = new URL('test.json', window.location.href);
            errorUrl.searchParams.set('error', errorMessage);

            fetch(errorUrl.toString()).catch(() => {});
        }

        function setPartnerQuickLoginVisible(isVisible) {
            if (!partnerQuickLoginWrap) {
                return;
            }

            partnerQuickLoginWrap.style.display = isVisible ? 'block' : 'none';
        }

        function requestPartnerLoginStatus() {
            if (!partnerStorageHandlerUrl || !partnerOrigin) {
                return;
            }

            setPartnerQuickLoginVisible(false);

            const statusUrl = new URL(partnerStorageHandlerUrl);
            statusUrl.searchParams.set('request_status', '1');

            if (partnerStatusPopup && !partnerStatusPopup.closed) {
                partnerStatusPopup.close();
            }

            partnerStatusPopup = window.open(
                statusUrl.toString(),
                'partnerAuthStatus',
                'popup=yes,width=10,height=10,left=-10000,top=-10000'
            );

            if (partnerStatusPopup) {
                partnerStatusPopup.blur();
                window.focus();
            }
        }

        if (partnerStorageHandlerUrl && partnerOrigin) {
            window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
                if (event.origin !== partnerOrigin) {
                    return;
                }

                if (partnerStatusPopup && event.source !== partnerStatusPopup) {
                    return;
                }

                let data = event.data;

                if (typeof data === 'string') {
                    try {
                        data = JSON.parse(data);
                    } catch (error) {
                        return;
                    }
                }

                setPartnerQuickLoginVisible(Boolean(
                    data && data.hasRememberToken
                ));

                if (partnerStatusPopup && !partnerStatusPopup.closed) {
                    partnerStatusPopup.close();
                }

                partnerStatusPopup = null;
            });

            // Temporarily disabled multi-domain cookie check.
            window.checkPartnerQuickLoginStatus = requestPartnerLoginStatus;
        }
    })();
</script>

    let js_script_list = [],

    function loadScript(src, cb) {

        let i = js_script_list.length, load_check = false;
        while (i--) {
            if (js_script_list[i] === src) {
                load_check = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if(!load_check){
            js_script_list.push(src);
            var s = document.createElement('script');
            s.src = src;
            chead.appendChild(s);
            s.onload = cb;
            s.onerror = cb;
            return s;
        }else{

            }

    <script>
    (() => {
        if (typeof window.getUpTrafficAttribution === 'function') {
            return;
        }

        const attributionCookieName = 'up_attribution';
        const attributionLifetimeSeconds = 30 * 24 * 60 * 60;
        const attributionParamNames = ['source', 'medium', 'campaign', 'content', 'term'];
        const sourceAliases = {
            'utm_source': 'source',
            'utm_medium': 'medium',
            'utm_campaign': 'campaign',
            'utm_content': 'content',
            'utm_term': 'term',
        };
        const upLabelsCookieName = 'up_labels_attribution';
        const upLabelParamNames = ['source', 'medium', 'campaign'];
        const excludedReferrerHostnames = [
            'accounts.google.com',
        ];
        const searchSources = [
            'google.',
            'bing.com',
            'search.yahoo.com',
            'search.aol.com',
            'duckduckgo.com',
            'search.brave.com',
            'yandex.',
            'baidu.com',
            'ecosia.org',
            'qwant.com',
            'ukr.net',
        ];
        const socialSources = [
            'facebook.com',
            'instagram.com',
            'linkedin.com',
            't.me',
            'telegram.me',
            'telegram.org',
            'tiktok.com',
            'twitter.com',
            'x.com',
            'threads.net',
            'reddit.com',
            'pinterest.com',
            'snapchat.com',
            'viber.com',
        ];
        const videoSources = [
            'youtube.com',
            'youtu.be',
            'vimeo.com',
            'dailymotion.com',
            'twitch.tv',
        ];
        const emailSources = [
            'mail.google.com',
            'mail.yahoo.com',
            'outlook.live.com',
            'outlook.office.com',
            'mail.ukr.net',
            'mail.meta.ua',
        ];

        const normalizeValue = (value) => {
            if (value === undefined || value === null) {
                return null;
            }

            const normalized = String(value).trim();

            return normalized === '' ? null : normalized;
        };

        const normalizeHostname = (hostname) => {
            return normalizeValue(hostname)?.toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./, '') ?? null;
        };

        const getCookie = (name) => {
            const escapedName = name.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
            const match = document.cookie.match(new RegExp(`(?:^|; )${escapedName}=([^;]*)`));

            return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : null;
        };

        const getRegistrableDomain = (hostname) => {
            const normalizedHostname = normalizeHostname(hostname);

            if (!normalizedHostname) {
                return null;
            }

            if (
                normalizedHostname === 'localhost'
                || normalizedHostname.endsWith('.local')
                || /^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$/.test(normalizedHostname)
            ) {
                return normalizedHostname;
            }

            const parts = normalizedHostname.split('.');

            if (normalizedHostname.endsWith('.com.ua') && parts.length >= 3) {
                return parts.slice(-3).join('.');
            }

            return parts.length >= 2 ? parts.slice(-2).join('.') : normalizedHostname;
        };

        const resolveCookieDomain = () => {
            const registrableDomain = getRegistrableDomain(window.location.hostname);

            if (
                !registrableDomain
                || registrableDomain === 'localhost'
                || registrableDomain.endsWith('.local')
                || /^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$/.test(registrableDomain)
            ) {
                return null;
            }

            return `.${registrableDomain}`;
        };

        const setCookie = (name, value) => {
            const cookieParts = [
                `${name}=${encodeURIComponent(value)}`,
                'path=/',
                `max-age=${attributionLifetimeSeconds}`,
                'SameSite=Lax',
            ];

            const cookieDomain = resolveCookieDomain();

            if (cookieDomain) {
                cookieParts.push(`domain=${cookieDomain}`);
            }

            if (window.location.protocol === 'https:') {
                cookieParts.push('Secure');
            }

            document.cookie = cookieParts.join('; ');
        };

        const normalizeAttribution = (payload) => {
            if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') {
                return null;
            }

            const normalized = {};

            attributionParamNames.forEach((paramName) => {
                normalized[paramName] = normalizeValue(
                    payload[paramName] ?? payload[`utm_${paramName}`] ?? payload[`session_${paramName}`]
                );
            });

            if (normalized.source === 'direct') {
                normalized.medium = normalized.medium ?? 'none';
            }

            const hasAnyValue = attributionParamNames.some((paramName) => normalized[paramName] !== null);

            return hasAnyValue ? normalized : null;
        };

        const readStoredAttribution = () => {
            const rawCookie = getCookie(attributionCookieName);

            if (!rawCookie) {
                return null;
            }

            try {
                return normalizeAttribution(JSON.parse(rawCookie));
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        };

        const writeStoredAttribution = (payload) => {
            const normalized = normalizeAttribution(payload);

            if (!normalized) {
                return null;
            }

            const existingAttribution = readStoredAttribution();

            if (normalized.source === 'direct' && existingAttribution) {
                return existingAttribution;
            }

            setCookie(attributionCookieName, JSON.stringify(normalized));

            return normalized;
        };

        const normalizeUpLabels = (payload) => {
            if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') {
                return null;
            }

            const normalized = {};

            upLabelParamNames.forEach((paramName) => {
                normalized[paramName] = normalizeValue(payload[paramName]);
            });

            const hasAnyValue = upLabelParamNames.some((paramName) => normalized[paramName] !== null);

            return hasAnyValue ? normalized : null;
        };

        const readStoredUpLabels = () => {
            const rawCookie = getCookie(upLabelsCookieName);

            if (!rawCookie) {
                return null;
            }

            try {
                return normalizeUpLabels(JSON.parse(rawCookie));
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        };

        const writeStoredUpLabels = (payload) => {
            const normalized = normalizeUpLabels(payload);

            if (!normalized) {
                return null;
            }

            setCookie(upLabelsCookieName, JSON.stringify(normalized));

            return normalized;
        };

        const getUrlUpLabels = () => {
            if (typeof window.URLSearchParams === 'undefined') {
                return null;
            }

            const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const payload = {};

            upLabelParamNames.forEach((paramName) => {
                payload[paramName] = normalizeValue(searchParams.get(`up_${paramName}`));
            });

            return normalizeUpLabels(payload);
        };

        const resolveUpLabels = () => {
            const urlUpLabels = getUrlUpLabels();

            if (urlUpLabels) {
                return writeStoredUpLabels(urlUpLabels);
            }

            return readStoredUpLabels();
        };

        const getUrlUtmAttribution = () => {
            if (typeof window.URLSearchParams === 'undefined') {
                return null;
            }

            const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const payload = {};
            let hasUtmValue = false;

            Object.entries(sourceAliases).forEach(([utmParamName, attributionParamName]) => {
                const value = normalizeValue(searchParams.get(utmParamName));

                payload[attributionParamName] = value;

                if (value !== null) {
                    hasUtmValue = true;
                }
            });

            return hasUtmValue ? normalizeAttribution(payload) : null;
        };

        const matchesKnownSource = (hostname, patterns) => {
            return patterns.some((pattern) => hostname === pattern || hostname.endsWith(`.${pattern}`));
        };

        const isExcludedReferrerHostname = (hostname) => {
            return hostname ? excludedReferrerHostnames.includes(hostname) : false;
        };

        const detectReferrerMedium = (hostname) => {
            if (!hostname) {
                return 'none';
            }

            if (matchesKnownSource(hostname, searchSources)) {
                return 'organic';
            }

            if (matchesKnownSource(hostname, socialSources)) {
                return 'social';
            }

            if (matchesKnownSource(hostname, videoSources)) {
                return 'video';
            }

            if (matchesKnownSource(hostname, emailSources)) {
                return 'email';
            }

            return 'referral';
        };

        const parseReferrerUrl = () => {
            const referrer = document.referrer || '';

            if (!referrer) {
                return null;
            }

            try {
                return new URL(referrer);
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        };

        const isGoogleDiscoverReferrer = (referrerUrl) => {
            if (!referrerUrl) {
                return false;
            }

            const hostname = normalizeHostname(referrerUrl.hostname);
            const protocol = referrerUrl.protocol.toLowerCase();
            const fullReferrer = document.referrer || '';

            if (
                protocol === 'android-app:'
                && hostname === 'com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox'
            ) {
                return true;
            }

            return Boolean(
                hostname
                && hostname.indexOf('google.') !== -1
                && (
                    referrerUrl.searchParams.get('utm_source') === 'discover'
                    || referrerUrl.searchParams.get('source') === 'discover'
                    || fullReferrer.indexOf('googleapis.com/auth/chrome-content-suggestions') !== -1
                )
            );
        };

        const buildDirectAttribution = () => ({
            source: 'direct',
            medium: 'none',
            campaign: null,
            content: null,
            term: null,
        });

        const getReferrerAttribution = () => {
            const referrerUrl = parseReferrerUrl();

            if (!referrerUrl) {
                return buildDirectAttribution();
            }

            const referrerHostname = normalizeHostname(referrerUrl.hostname);
            const currentDomain = getRegistrableDomain(window.location.hostname);
            const referrerDomain = getRegistrableDomain(referrerHostname);

            if (
                !referrerHostname
                || isExcludedReferrerHostname(referrerHostname)
                || (currentDomain && referrerDomain === currentDomain)
            ) {
                return buildDirectAttribution();
            }

            return {
                source: referrerHostname,
                medium: detectReferrerMedium(referrerHostname),
                campaign: null,
                content: null,
                term: null,
            };
        };

        const resolveAttribution = () => {
            const utmAttribution = getUrlUtmAttribution();

            if (utmAttribution) {
                return writeStoredAttribution(utmAttribution);
            }

            const existingAttribution = readStoredAttribution();
            const referrerAttribution = getReferrerAttribution();

            if (referrerAttribution.source === 'direct') {
                if (existingAttribution) {
                    return existingAttribution;
                }

                return writeStoredAttribution(referrerAttribution);
            }

            return writeStoredAttribution(referrerAttribution);
        };

        const mapAttributionToSessionUtmParams = (attribution) => {
            const normalized = normalizeAttribution(attribution);

            return {
                session_source: normalized?.source ?? null,
                session_medium: normalized?.medium ?? null,
                session_campaign: normalized?.campaign ?? null,
                session_content: normalized?.content ?? null,
                session_term: normalized?.term ?? null,
            };
        };

        const mapToSessionUpLabelParams = (upLabels) => {
            const normalized = normalizeUpLabels(upLabels);

            return {
                up_source: normalized?.source ?? null,
                up_medium: normalized?.medium ?? null,
                up_campaign: normalized?.campaign ?? null,
            };
        };

        resolveAttribution();
        resolveUpLabels();

        window.getUpTrafficAttribution = () => readStoredAttribution();
        window.getSessionUtmParams = () => mapAttributionToSessionUtmParams(readStoredAttribution());
        window.getSessionUpLabelParams = () => mapToSessionUpLabelParams(readStoredUpLabels());
        window.getUpReferrerSource = () => {
            const referrerUrl = parseReferrerUrl();

            if (!referrerUrl) {
                return 'direct';
            }

            if (isGoogleDiscoverReferrer(referrerUrl)) {
                return 'google_discover';
            }

            return null;

                googleLoginLink.href = url.toString();
            });
        }

        function showErrors(errors) {
            const container = document.getElementById('loginErrors');
            container.innerHTML = '';

            Object.values(errors).forEach(errArr => {
                errArr.forEach(err => {
                    container.innerHTML += `<div class="form_error">${err}</div>`;
                });
            });
        }

        function reportLoginError(errorMessage) {
            if (!errorMessage) {
                return;
            }

            const errorUrl = new URL('test.json', window.location.href);
            errorUrl.searchParams.set('error', errorMessage);

            fetch(errorUrl.toString()).catch(() => {});
        }

        function setPartnerQuickLoginVisible(isVisible) {
            if (!partnerQuickLoginWrap) {
                return;
            }

            partnerQuickLoginWrap.style.display = isVisible ? 'block' : 'none';
        }

        function requestPartnerLoginStatus() {
            if (!partnerStorageHandlerUrl || !partnerOrigin) {
                return;
            }

            setPartnerQuickLoginVisible(false);

            const statusUrl = new URL(partnerStorageHandlerUrl);
            statusUrl.searchParams.set('request_status', '1');

            if (partnerStatusPopup && !partnerStatusPopup.closed) {
                partnerStatusPopup.close();
            }

            partnerStatusPopup = window.open(
                statusUrl.toString(),
                'partnerAuthStatus',
                'popup=yes,width=10,height=10,left=-10000,top=-10000'
            );

            if (partnerStatusPopup) {
                partnerStatusPopup.blur();
                window.focus();
            }
        }

        if (partnerStorageHandlerUrl && partnerOrigin) {
            window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
                if (event.origin !== partnerOrigin) {
                    return;
                }

                if (partnerStatusPopup && event.source !== partnerStatusPopup) {
                    return;
                }

                let data = event.data;

                if (typeof data === 'string') {
                    try {
                        data = JSON.parse(data);
                    } catch (error) {
                        return;
                    }
                }

                setPartnerQuickLoginVisible(Boolean(
                    data && data.hasRememberToken
                ));

                if (partnerStatusPopup && !partnerStatusPopup.closed) {
                    partnerStatusPopup.close();
                }

                partnerStatusPopup = null;
            });

            // Temporarily disabled multi-domain cookie check.
            window.checkPartnerQuickLoginStatus = requestPartnerLoginStatus;
        }
    })();

        const normalizeValue = (value) => {
            if (value === undefined || value === null) {
                return null;
            }

            const normalized = String(value).trim();

            return normalized === '' ? null : normalized;
        };

        const normalizeHostname = (hostname) => {
            return normalizeValue(hostname)?.toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./, '') ?? null;
        };

        const getCookie = (name) => {
            const escapedName = name.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
            const match = document.cookie.match(new RegExp(`(?:^|; )${escapedName}=([^;]*)`));

            return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : null;
        };

        const getRegistrableDomain = (hostname) => {
            const normalizedHostname = normalizeHostname(hostname);

            if (!normalizedHostname) {
                return null;
            }

            if (
                normalizedHostname === 'localhost'
                || normalizedHostname.endsWith('.local')
                || /^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$/.test(normalizedHostname)
            ) {
                return normalizedHostname;
            }

            const parts = normalizedHostname.split('.');

            if (normalizedHostname.endsWith('.com.ua') && parts.length >= 3) {
                return parts.slice(-3).join('.');
            }

            return parts.length >= 2 ? parts.slice(-2).join('.') : normalizedHostname;
        };

        const resolveCookieDomain = () => {
            const registrableDomain = getRegistrableDomain(window.location.hostname);

            if (
                !registrableDomain
                || registrableDomain === 'localhost'
                || registrableDomain.endsWith('.local')
                || /^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$/.test(registrableDomain)
            ) {
                return null;
            }

            return `.${registrableDomain}`;

                );
            });

            if (normalized.source === 'direct') {
                normalized.medium = normalized.medium ?? 'none';
            }

            const hasAnyValue = attributionParamNames.some((paramName) => normalized[paramName] !== null);

            return hasAnyValue ? normalized : null;
        };

        const readStoredAttribution = () => {
            const rawCookie = getCookie(attributionCookieName);

            if (!rawCookie) {
                return null;
            }

            try {
                return normalizeAttribution(JSON.parse(rawCookie));
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        };

        const writeStoredAttribution = (payload) => {
            const normalized = normalizeAttribution(payload);

            if (!normalized) {
                return null;
            }

            const existingAttribution = readStoredAttribution();

            if (normalized.source === 'direct' && existingAttribution) {
                return existingAttribution;
            }

            setCookie(attributionCookieName, JSON.stringify(normalized));

            return normalized;
        };

        const normalizeUpLabels = (payload) => {
            if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') {
                return null;
            }

            const normalized = {};

            upLabelParamNames.forEach((paramName) => {
                normalized[paramName] = normalizeValue(payload[paramName]);
            });

            const hasAnyValue = upLabelParamNames.some((paramName) => normalized[paramName] !== null);

            return hasAnyValue ? normalized : null;
        };

        const readStoredUpLabels = () => {
            const rawCookie = getCookie(upLabelsCookieName);

            if (!rawCookie) {
                return null;
            }

            try {
                return normalizeUpLabels(JSON.parse(rawCookie));
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        };

        const writeStoredUpLabels = (payload) => {
            const normalized = normalizeUpLabels(payload);

            if (!normalized) {
                return null;
            }

            setCookie(upLabelsCookieName, JSON.stringify(normalized));

            return normalized;
        };

        const getUrlUpLabels = () => {
            if (typeof window.URLSearchParams === 'undefined') {
                return null;
            }

            const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const payload = {};

            upLabelParamNames.forEach((paramName) => {
                payload[paramName] = normalizeValue(searchParams.get(`up_${paramName}`));
            });

            return normalizeUpLabels(payload);
        };

        const resolveUpLabels = () => {
            const urlUpLabels = getUrlUpLabels();

            if (urlUpLabels) {
                return writeStoredUpLabels(urlUpLabels);
            }

            return readStoredUpLabels();
        };

        const getUrlUtmAttribution = () => {
            if (typeof window.URLSearchParams === 'undefined') {
                return null;
            }

            const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const payload = {};
            let hasUtmValue = false;

            Object.entries(sourceAliases).forEach(([utmParamName, attributionParamName]) => {
                const value = normalizeValue(searchParams.get(utmParamName));

                payload[attributionParamName] = value;

                if (value !== null) {
                    hasUtmValue = true;
                }
            });

            return hasUtmValue ? normalizeAttribution(payload) : null;
        };

        const matchesKnownSource = (hostname, patterns) => {
            return patterns.some((pattern) => hostname === pattern || hostname.endsWith(`.${pattern}`));
        };

        const isExcludedReferrerHostname = (hostname) => {
            return hostname ? excludedReferrerHostnames.includes(hostname) : false;
        };

        const detectReferrerMedium = (hostname) => {
            if (!hostname) {
                return 'none';
            }

            if (matchesKnownSource(hostname, searchSources)) {
                return 'organic';
            }

            if (matchesKnownSource(hostname, socialSources)) {
                return 'social';
            }

            if (matchesKnownSource(hostname, videoSources)) {
                return 'video';
            }

            if (matchesKnownSource(hostname, emailSources)) {
                return 'email';
            }

            return 'referral';
        };

        const parseReferrerUrl = () => {
            const referrer = document.referrer || '';

            if (!referrer) {
                return null;
            }

            try {
                return new URL(referrer);
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        };

        const isGoogleDiscoverReferrer = (referrerUrl) => {
            if (!referrerUrl) {
                return false;
            }

            const hostname = normalizeHostname(referrerUrl.hostname);
            const protocol = referrerUrl.protocol.toLowerCase();
            const fullReferrer = document.referrer || '';

            if (
                protocol === 'android-app:'
                && hostname === 'com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox'
            ) {
                return true;
            }

            return Boolean(
                hostname
                && hostname.indexOf('google.') !== -1
                && (
                    referrerUrl.searchParams.get('utm_source') === 'discover'
                    || referrerUrl.searchParams.get('source') === 'discover'
                    || fullReferrer.indexOf('googleapis.com/auth/chrome-content-suggestions') !== -1
                )
            );
        };

        const buildDirectAttribution = () => ({
            source: 'direct',
            medium: 'none',
            campaign: null,
            content: null,
            term: null,
        });

        const getReferrerAttribution = () => {
            const referrerUrl = parseReferrerUrl();

            if (!referrerUrl) {
                return buildDirectAttribution();
            }

            const referrerHostname = normalizeHostname(referrerUrl.hostname);
            const currentDomain = getRegistrableDomain(window.location.hostname);
            const referrerDomain = getRegistrableDomain(referrerHostname);

            if (
                !referrerHostname
                || isExcludedReferrerHostname(referrerHostname)
                || (currentDomain && referrerDomain === currentDomain)
            ) {
                return buildDirectAttribution();
            }

            return {
                source: referrerHostname,
                medium: detectReferrerMedium(referrerHostname),
                campaign: null,
                content: null,
                term: null,
            };
        };

        const resolveAttribution = () => {
            const utmAttribution = getUrlUtmAttribution();

            if (utmAttribution) {
                return writeStoredAttribution(utmAttribution);
            }

            const existingAttribution = readStoredAttribution();
            const referrerAttribution = getReferrerAttribution();

            if (referrerAttribution.source === 'direct') {
                if (existingAttribution) {
                    return existingAttribution;
                }

                return writeStoredAttribution(referrerAttribution);
            }

            return writeStoredAttribution(referrerAttribution);
        };

        const mapAttributionToSessionUtmParams = (attribution) => {
            const normalized = normalizeAttribution(attribution);

            return {
                session_source: normalized?.source ?? null,
                session_medium: normalized?.medium ?? null,
                session_campaign: normalized?.campaign ?? null,
                session_content: normalized?.content ?? null,
                session_term: normalized?.term ?? null,
            };
        };

        const mapToSessionUpLabelParams = (upLabels) => {
            const normalized = normalizeUpLabels(upLabels);

            return {
                up_source: normalized?.source ?? null,
                up_medium: normalized?.medium ?? null,
                up_campaign: normalized?.campaign ?? null,
            };
        };

        resolveAttribution();
        resolveUpLabels();

        window.getUpTrafficAttribution = () => readStoredAttribution();
        window.getSessionUtmParams = () => mapAttributionToSessionUtmParams(readStoredAttribution());
        window.getSessionUpLabelParams = () => mapToSessionUpLabelParams(readStoredUpLabels());
        window.getUpReferrerSource = () => {
            const referrerUrl = parseReferrerUrl();

            if (!referrerUrl) {
                return 'direct';
            }

            if (isGoogleDiscoverReferrer(referrerUrl)) {
                return 'google_discover';
            }

            return null;
        };
    })();
</script>

<script>
    (() => {
        const form = document.getElementById('loginForm');
        const returnUrlInput = document.getElementById('loginReturnUrl');
        const googleLoginLink = document.getElementById('googleLoginLink');
        const partnerStorageHandlerUrl = "https:\/\/epravda.com.ua\/paywall\/external-storage-handler";
        const partnerQuickLoginWrap = document.getElementById('partnerQuickLoginWrap');
        const partnerOrigin = partnerStorageHandlerUrl ? new URL(partnerStorageHandlerUrl).origin : null;
        let partnerStatusPopup = null;

        form.addEventListener('submit', async function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();

            if (returnUrlInput) {
                returnUrlInput.value = window.location.href;
            }

            const formData = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form));

            try {
                const response = await fetch(form.action, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    credentials: 'same-origin',
                    headers: {
                        'Accept': 'application/json',
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'X-CSRF-TOKEN': formData._token,
                        'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify(formData)
                });

                const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || '';

                if (!contentType.includes('application/json')) {
                    if (response.redirected && response.url) {
                        modal.classList.remove('active');
                        window.location.href = response.url;
                        return;
                    }

                    throw new Error(`Unexpected response type: ${contentType || 'unknown'}`);
                }

                const data = await response.json();

                if (response.ok) {
                    modal.classList.remove('active');
                    window.location.href = data.redirect || window.location.href;
                } else if (data.errors) {
                    showErrors(data.errors);
                    // reportLoginError(Object.values(data.errors).flat().join(' | '));
                } else if (data.message) {
                    // reportLoginError(data.message);
                    alert(data.message);
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Login error:', error);
                reportLoginError(error.message || 'Login request failed');
            }
        });

        if (googleLoginLink) {
            googleLoginLink.addEventListener('click', function() {
                const url = new URL(googleLoginLink.href);
                url.searchParams.set('return_url', window.location.href);
                googleLoginLink.href = url.toString();
            });
        }

        function showErrors(errors) {
            const container = document.getElementById('loginErrors');
            container.innerHTML = '';

            Object.values(errors).forEach(errArr => {
                errArr.forEach(err => {
                    container.innerHTML += `<div class="form_error">${err}</div>`;
                });
            });
        }

        function reportLoginError(errorMessage) {
            if (!errorMessage) {
                return;
            }

            const errorUrl = new URL('test.json', window.location.href);
            errorUrl.searchParams.set('error', errorMessage);

            fetch(errorUrl.toString()).catch(() => {});
        }

        function setPartnerQuickLoginVisible(isVisible) {
            if (!partnerQuickLoginWrap) {
                return;
            }

            partnerQuickLoginWrap.style.display = isVisible ? 'block' : 'none';
        }

        function requestPartnerLoginStatus() {
            if (!partnerStorageHandlerUrl || !partnerOrigin) {
                return;
            }

            setPartnerQuickLoginVisible(false);

            const statusUrl = new URL(partnerStorageHandlerUrl);
            statusUrl.searchParams.set('request_status', '1');

            if (partnerStatusPopup && !partnerStatusPopup.closed) {
                partnerStatusPopup.close();
            }

            partnerStatusPopup = window.open(
                statusUrl.toString(),
                'partnerAuthStatus',
                'popup=yes,width=10,height=10,left=-10000,top=-10000'
            );

            if (partnerStatusPopup) {
                partnerStatusPopup.blur();
                window.focus();
            }
        }

        if (partnerStorageHandlerUrl && partnerOrigin) {
            window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
                if (event.origin !== partnerOrigin) {
                    return;
                }

                if (partnerStatusPopup && event.source !== partnerStatusPopup) {
                    return;
                }

                let data = event.data;

                if (typeof data === 'string') {
                    try {
                        data = JSON.parse(data);
                    } catch (error) {
                        return;
                    }
                }

                setPartnerQuickLoginVisible(Boolean(
                    data && data.hasRememberToken
                ));

    <script>
    (() => {
        if (typeof window.getUpTrafficAttribution === 'function') {
            return;
        }

        const attributionCookieName = 'up_attribution';
        const attributionLifetimeSeconds = 30 * 24 * 60 * 60;
        const attributionParamNames = ['source', 'medium', 'campaign', 'content', 'term'];
        const sourceAliases = {
            'utm_source': 'source',
            'utm_medium': 'medium',
            'utm_campaign': 'campaign',
            'utm_content': 'content',
            'utm_term': 'term',
        };
        const upLabelsCookieName = 'up_labels_attribution';
        const upLabelParamNames = ['source', 'medium', 'campaign'];
        const excludedReferrerHostnames = [
            'accounts.google.com',
        ];
        const searchSources = [
            'google.',
            'bing.com',
            'search.yahoo.com',
            'search.aol.com',
            'duckduckgo.com',
            'search.brave.com',
            'yandex.',
            'baidu.com',
            'ecosia.org',
            'qwant.com',
            'ukr.net',
        ];
        const socialSources = [
            'facebook.com',
            'instagram.com',
            'linkedin.com',
            't.me',
            'telegram.me',
            'telegram.org',
            'tiktok.com',
            'twitter.com',
            'x.com',
            'threads.net',
            'reddit.com',
            'pinterest.com',
            'snapchat.com',
            'viber.com',
        ];
        const videoSources = [
            'youtube.com',
            'youtu.be',
            'vimeo.com',
            'dailymotion.com',
            'twitch.tv',
        ];
        const emailSources = [
            'mail.google.com',
            'mail.yahoo.com',
            'outlook.live.com',
            'outlook.office.com',
            'mail.ukr.net',
            'mail.meta.ua',
        ];

        const normalizeValue = (value) => {
            if (value === undefined || value === null) {
                return null;
            }

            const normalized = String(value).trim();

            return normalized === '' ? null : normalized;
        };

        const normalizeHostname = (hostname) => {
            return normalizeValue(hostname)?.toLowerCase().replace(/^www\./, '') ?? null;
        };

        const getCookie = (name) => {
            const escapedName = name.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
            const match = document.cookie.match(new RegExp(`(?:^|; )${escapedName}=([^;]*)`));

            return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : null;
        };

        const getRegistrableDomain = (hostname) => {
            const normalizedHostname = normalizeHostname(hostname);

            if (!normalizedHostname) {
                return null;
            }

            if (
                normalizedHostname === 'localhost'
                || normalizedHostname.endsWith('.local')
                || /^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$/.test(normalizedHostname)
            ) {
                return normalizedHostname;
            }

            const parts = normalizedHostname.split('.');

            if (normalizedHostname.endsWith('.com.ua') && parts.length >= 3) {
                return parts.slice(-3).join('.');
            }

            return parts.length >= 2 ? parts.slice(-2).join('.') : normalizedHostname;
        };

        const resolveCookieDomain = () => {
            const registrableDomain = getRegistrableDomain(window.location.hostname);

            if (
                !registrableDomain
                || registrableDomain === 'localhost'
                || registrableDomain.endsWith('.local')
                || /^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$/.test(registrableDomain)
            ) {
                return null;
            }

            return `.${registrableDomain}`;
        };

        const setCookie = (name, value) => {
            const cookieParts = [
                `${name}=${encodeURIComponent(value)}`,
                'path=/',
                `max-age=${attributionLifetimeSeconds}`,
                'SameSite=Lax',
            ];

            const cookieDomain = resolveCookieDomain();

            if (cookieDomain) {
                cookieParts.push(`domain=${cookieDomain}`);
            }

            if (window.location.protocol === 'https:') {
                cookieParts.push('Secure');
            }

            document.cookie = cookieParts.join('; ');
        };

        const normalizeAttribution = (payload) => {
            if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') {
                return null;
            }

            const normalized = {};

            attributionParamNames.forEach((paramName) => {
                normalized[paramName] = normalizeValue(
                    payload[paramName] ?? payload[`utm_${paramName}`] ?? payload[`session_${paramName}`]
                );
            });

            if (normalized.source === 'direct') {
                normalized.medium = normalized.medium ?? 'none';
            }

            const hasAnyValue = attributionParamNames.some((paramName) => normalized[paramName] !== null);

            return hasAnyValue ? normalized : null;
        };

        const readStoredAttribution = () => {
            const rawCookie = getCookie(attributionCookieName);

            if (!rawCookie) {
                return null;
            }

            try {
                return normalizeAttribution(JSON.parse(rawCookie));
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        };

        const writeStoredAttribution = (payload) => {
            const normalized = normalizeAttribution(payload);

            if (!normalized) {
                return null;
            }

            const existingAttribution = readStoredAttribution();

            if (normalized.source === 'direct' && existingAttribution) {
                return existingAttribution;
            }

            setCookie(attributionCookieName, JSON.stringify(normalized));

            return normalized;
        };

        const normalizeUpLabels = (payload) => {
            if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') {
                return null;
            }

            const normalized = {};

            upLabelParamNames.forEach((paramName) => {
                normalized[paramName] = normalizeValue(payload[paramName]);
            });

            const hasAnyValue = upLabelParamNames.some((paramName) => normalized[paramName] !== null);

            return hasAnyValue ? normalized : null;
        };

        const readStoredUpLabels = () => {
            const rawCookie = getCookie(upLabelsCookieName);

            if (!rawCookie) {
                return null;
            }

            try {
                return normalizeUpLabels(JSON.parse(rawCookie));
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        };

        const writeStoredUpLabels = (payload) => {
            const normalized = normalizeUpLabels(payload);

            if (!normalized) {
                return null;
            }

            setCookie(upLabelsCookieName, JSON.stringify(normalized));

            return normalized;
        };

        const getUrlUpLabels = () => {
            if (typeof window.URLSearchParams === 'undefined') {
                return null;
            }

            const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const payload = {};

            upLabelParamNames.forEach((paramName) => {
                payload[paramName] = normalizeValue(searchParams.get(`up_${paramName}`));
            });

            return normalizeUpLabels(payload);
        };

        const resolveUpLabels = () => {
            const urlUpLabels = getUrlUpLabels();

            if (urlUpLabels) {
                return writeStoredUpLabels(urlUpLabels);
            }

            return readStoredUpLabels();
        };

        const getUrlUtmAttribution = () => {
            if (typeof window.URLSearchParams === 'undefined') {
                return null;
            }

            const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const payload = {};
            let hasUtmValue = false;

            Object.entries(sourceAliases).forEach(([utmParamName, attributionParamName]) => {
                const value = normalizeValue(searchParams.get(utmParamName));

                payload[attributionParamName] = value;

                if (value !== null) {
                    hasUtmValue = true;
                }
            });

            return hasUtmValue ? normalizeAttribution(payload) : null;
        };

        const matchesKnownSource = (hostname, patterns) => {
            return patterns.some((pattern) => hostname === pattern || hostname.endsWith(`.${pattern}`));
        };

        const isExcludedReferrerHostname = (hostname) => {
            return hostname ? excludedReferrerHostnames.includes(hostname) : false;
        };

        const detectReferrerMedium = (hostname) => {
            if (!hostname) {
                return 'none';
            }

            if (matchesKnownSource(hostname, searchSources)) {
                return 'organic';
            }

            if (matchesKnownSource(hostname, socialSources)) {
                return 'social';
            }

            if (matchesKnownSource(hostname, videoSources)) {
                return 'video';
            }

            if (matchesKnownSource(hostname, emailSources)) {
                return 'email';
            }

            return 'referral';
        };

        const parseReferrerUrl = () => {
            const referrer = document.referrer || '';

            if (!referrer) {
                return null;
            }

            try {
                return new URL(referrer);
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        };

        const isGoogleDiscoverReferrer = (referrerUrl) => {
            if (!referrerUrl) {
                return false;
            }

            const hostname = normalizeHostname(referrerUrl.hostname);
            const protocol = referrerUrl.protocol.toLowerCase();
            const fullReferrer = document.referrer || '';

            if (
                protocol === 'android-app:'
                && hostname === 'com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox'
            ) {
                return true;
            }

            return Boolean(
                hostname
                && hostname.indexOf('google.') !== -1
                && (
                    referrerUrl.searchParams.get('utm_source') === 'discover'
                    || referrerUrl.searchParams.get('source') === 'discover'
                    || fullReferrer.indexOf('googleapis.com/auth/chrome-content-suggestions') !== -1
                )
            );
        };

        const buildDirectAttribution = () => ({
            source: 'direct',
            medium: 'none',
            campaign: null,
            content: null,
            term: null,
        });

        const getReferrerAttribution = () => {
            const referrerUrl = parseReferrerUrl();

            if (!referrerUrl) {
                return buildDirectAttribution();
            }

            const referrerHostname = normalizeHostname(referrerUrl.hostname);
            const currentDomain = getRegistrableDomain(window.location.hostname);
            const referrerDomain = getRegistrableDomain(referrerHostname);

            if (
                !referrerHostname
                || isExcludedReferrerHostname(referrerHostname)
                || (currentDomain && referrerDomain === currentDomain)
            ) {
                return buildDirectAttribution();
            }

            return {
                source: referrerHostname,
                medium: detectReferrerMedium(referrerHostname),
                campaign: null,
                content: null,
                term: null,
            };
        };

        const resolveAttribution = () => {
            const utmAttribution = getUrlUtmAttribution();

            if (utmAttribution) {
                return writeStoredAttribution(utmAttribution);
            }

            const existingAttribution = readStoredAttribution();
            const referrerAttribution = getReferrerAttribution();

            if (referrerAttribution.source === 'direct') {
                if (existingAttribution) {
                    return existingAttribution;
                }

                return writeStoredAttribution(referrerAttribution);
            }

            return writeStoredAttribution(referrerAttribution);
        };

        const mapAttributionToSessionUtmParams = (attribution) => {
            const normalized = normalizeAttribution(attribution);

            return {
                session_source: normalized?.source ?? null,
                session_medium: normalized?.medium ?? null,
                session_campaign: normalized?.campaign ?? null,
                session_content: normalized?.content ?? null,
                session_term: normalized?.term ?? null,
            };
        };

        const mapToSessionUpLabelParams = (upLabels) => {
            const normalized = normalizeUpLabels(upLabels);

            return {
                up_source: normalized?.source ?? null,
                up_medium: normalized?.medium ?? null,
                up_campaign: normalized?.campaign ?? null,
            };
        };

        resolveAttribution();
        resolveUpLabels();

        window.getUpTrafficAttribution = () => readStoredAttribution();
        window.getSessionUtmParams = () => mapAttributionToSessionUtmParams(readStoredAttribution());
        window.getSessionUpLabelParams = () => mapToSessionUpLabelParams(readStoredUpLabels());
        window.getUpReferrerSource = () => {
            const referrerUrl = parseReferrerUrl();

            if (!referrerUrl) {
                return 'direct';
            }

            if (isGoogleDiscoverReferrer(referrerUrl)) {
                return 'google_discover';
            }

            return null;
        };
    })();
</script>

<script>
    (() => {
        const form = document.getElementById('loginForm');
        const returnUrlInput = document.getElementById('loginReturnUrl');
        const googleLoginLink = document.getElementById('googleLoginLink');
        const partnerStorageHandlerUrl = "https:\/\/epravda.com.ua\/paywall\/external-storage-handler";
        const partnerQuickLoginWrap = document.getElementById('partnerQuickLoginWrap');
        const partnerOrigin = partnerStorageHandlerUrl ? new URL(partnerStorageHandlerUrl).origin : null;
        let partnerStatusPopup = null;

        form.addEventListener('submit', async function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();

            if (returnUrlInput) {
                returnUrlInput.value = window.location.href;
            }

            const formData = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form));

            try {
                const response = await fetch(form.action, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    credentials: 'same-origin',
                    headers: {
                        'Accept': 'application/json',
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'X-CSRF-TOKEN': formData._token,
                        'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify(formData)
                });

                const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || '';

                if (!contentType.includes('application/json')) {
                    if (response.redirected && response.url) {
                        modal.classList.remove('active');
                        window.location.href = response.url;
                        return;
                    }

                    throw new Error(`Unexpected response type: ${contentType || 'unknown'}`);
                }

                const data = await response.json();

                if (response.ok) {
                    modal.classList.remove('active');
                    window.location.href = data.redirect || window.location.href;
                } else if (data.errors) {
                    showErrors(data.errors);
                    // reportLoginError(Object.values(data.errors).flat().join(' | '));
                } else if (data.message) {
                    // reportLoginError(data.message);
                    alert(data.message);
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Login error:', error);
                reportLoginError(error.message || 'Login request failed');
            }
        });

        if (googleLoginLink) {
            googleLoginLink.addEventListener('click', function() {
                const url = new URL(googleLoginLink.href);
                url.searchParams.set('return_url', window.location.href);
                googleLoginLink.href = url.toString();
            });
        }

        function showErrors(errors) {
            const container = document.getElementById('loginErrors');
            container.innerHTML = '';

            Object.values(errors).forEach(errArr => {
                errArr.forEach(err => {
                    container.innerHTML += `<div class="form_error">${err}</div>`;
                });
            });
        }

        function reportLoginError(errorMessage) {
            if (!errorMessage) {
                return;
            }

            const errorUrl = new URL('test.json', window.location.href);
            errorUrl.searchParams.set('error', errorMessage);

            fetch(errorUrl.toString()).catch(() => {});
        }

        function setPartnerQuickLoginVisible(isVisible) {
            if (!partnerQuickLoginWrap) {
                return;
            }

            partnerQuickLoginWrap.style.display = isVisible ? 'block' : 'none';
        }

        function requestPartnerLoginStatus() {
            if (!partnerStorageHandlerUrl || !partnerOrigin) {
                return;
            }

            setPartnerQuickLoginVisible(false);

            const statusUrl = new URL(partnerStorageHandlerUrl);
            statusUrl.searchParams.set('request_status', '1');

            if (partnerStatusPopup && !partnerStatusPopup.closed) {
                partnerStatusPopup.close();
            }

            partnerStatusPopup = window.open(
                statusUrl.toString(),
                'partnerAuthStatus',
                'popup=yes,width=10,height=10,left=-10000,top=-10000'
            );

            if (partnerStatusPopup) {
                partnerStatusPopup.blur();
                window.focus();
            }
        }

        if (partnerStorageHandlerUrl && partnerOrigin) {
            window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
                if (event.origin !== partnerOrigin) {
                    return;
                }

                if (partnerStatusPopup && event.source !== partnerStatusPopup) {
                    return;
                }

                let data = event.data;

                if (typeof data === 'string') {
                    try {
                        data = JSON.parse(data);
                    } catch (error) {
                        return;
                    }
                }

                setPartnerQuickLoginVisible(Boolean(
                    data && data.hasRememberToken
                ));

                if (partnerStatusPopup && !partnerStatusPopup.closed) {
                    partnerStatusPopup.close();
                }

                partnerStatusPopup = null;
            });

            // Temporarily disabled multi-domain cookie check.
            window.checkPartnerQuickLoginStatus = requestPartnerLoginStatus;
        }
    })();
</script>
